'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Allen Gaible DS Coruscant''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Allen Gaible]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition)|SE-D-coruscant.gif|label=Coruscant}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
